questions.q: If + means −, − means ×, × means ÷ and ÷ means +, then what is the value of 12 + 5 − 3 × 3 ÷ 4?
questions.e: Replace the signs: 12 − 5 × 3 ÷ 3 + 4. By BODMAS, 5 × 3 ÷ 3 = 5, then 12 − 5 + 4 = 11.

questions.q:
Which two signs should be interchanged to make the following equation correct?
12 ÷ 6 × 9 − 2 + 12 = 18
questions.e: Interchanging × and ÷ gives 12 × 6 ÷ 9 − 2 + 12 = 8 − 2 + 12 = 18, which matches. Each of the other swaps gives a different value.

questions.q: If P stands for ÷, Q stands for ×, R stands for + and S stands for −, then what is the value of 36 R 9 Q 5 P 3 S 4?
questions.e: Substituting gives 36 + 9 × 5 ÷ 3 − 4. By BODMAS, 9 × 5 ÷ 3 = 15, so the value is 36 + 15 − 4 = 47.

questions.q: If × means +, ÷ means −, + means ÷ and − means ×, then what is the value of 24 + 6 × 15 − 2 ÷ 7?
questions.e: Replacing the signs gives 24 ÷ 6 + 15 × 2 − 7. Division and multiplication first: 4 + 30 − 7 = 27.

questions.q:
Which two signs should be interchanged to make the following equation correct?
11 ÷ 2 + 9 × 7 − 9 = 16
questions.e: Interchanging − and ÷ gives 11 − 2 + 9 × 7 ÷ 9 = 11 − 2 + 7 = 16. No other swap gives 16.

questions.q: If 3 and 7 are interchanged, which of the following equations becomes correct?
questions.e: After interchanging 3 and 7, the correct equation reads 7 − 3 × 9 = −20, which is true. The other three equations become false.

questions.q: If + means ×, × means −, − means ÷ and ÷ means +, which of the following equations is correct?
questions.e: For the correct equation, replace the signs: it becomes 8 × 9 + 3 = 75, which is true by BODMAS. The other three do not hold after replacement.

questions.q:
Which interchange of signs and numbers will make the following equation correct?
8 ÷ 4 + 3 × 11 = 25
questions.e: Interchange + and ×, and also 3 and 11: 8 ÷ 4 × 11 + 3 = 2 × 11 + 3 = 25. The other options give different values.

questions.q: For numbers a and b, let a @ b = a² − b and a # b = 2a + b. What is the value of (3 @ 4) # (2 @ 1)?
If + means ×, − means +, × means ÷ and ÷ means −, then what is the value of 18 ÷ 4 + 3 × 6 − 5?
questions.e: Replacing the signs gives 18 − 4 × 3 ÷ 6 + 5. Multiplication and division come first, left to right: 4 × 3 ÷ 6 = 2. Then 18 − 2 + 5 = 21.
